using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.AudioToText;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureOpenAI;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.AzureOpenAI.Tests.Extensions;

public class AzureOpenAIKernelBuilderExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_WithOpenAIClient_CallsGetServiceOnServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        services.AddSingleton(mockLoggerFactory.Object);

        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();
        builder.Services.Add(services);

        var mockClient = new Mock<AzureOpenAIClient>().Object;
        const string deploymentName = "test-deployment";
        const string serviceId = "test-service";
        const string modelId = "test-model";

        // Act
        builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(deploymentName, mockClient, serviceId, modelId);

        // Assert - Verify the factory was registered and exercises GetService<ILoggerFactory>()
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var keyedService = serviceProvider.GetServices<IAudioToTextService>().OfType<KeyedService>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.ServiceId == serviceId);
        Assert.NotNull(keyedService);

        // Trigger factory invocation to ensure GetService was called
        var audioService = (AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService)keyedService.GetService(serviceProvider);
        Assert.NotNull(audioService);
        Assert.Equal(deploymentName, audioService.DeploymentName);
        Assert.Equal(modelId, audioService.ModelId);
        mockLoggerFactory.Verify(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_WithoutOpenAIClient_UsesGetRequiredService()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
        var mockClient = new Mock<AzureOpenAIClient>().Object;
        services.AddSingleton(mockClient);
        services.AddSingleton(mockLoggerFactory.Object);

        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();
        builder.Services.Add(services);

        const string deploymentName = "test-deployment";
        const string serviceId = "test-service";

        // Act
        builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(deploymentName, serviceId: serviceId);

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var keyedService = serviceProvider.GetServices<IAudioToTextService>().OfType<KeyedService>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.ServiceId == serviceId);
        Assert.NotNull(keyedService);

        var audioService = (AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService)keyedService.GetService(serviceProvider);
        Assert.NotNull(audioService);
        mockLoggerFactory.Verify(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>()), Times.AtLeastOnce);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_NullLoggerFactory_ReturnsNullLogger()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        // No ILoggerFactory registered

        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();
        builder.Services.Add(services);

        var mockClient = new Mock<AzureOpenAIClient>().Object;
        const string deploymentName = "test-deployment";
        const string serviceId = "test-service";

        // Act
        builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(deploymentName, mockClient, serviceId, null);

        // Assert - GetService<ILoggerFactory>() returns null, which is handled by AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var keyedService = serviceProvider.GetServices<IAudioToTextService>().OfType<KeyedService>().FirstOrDefault(s => s.ServiceId == serviceId);
        Assert.NotNull(keyedService);

        var audioService = (AzureOpenAIAudioToTextService)keyedService.GetService(serviceProvider);
        Assert.NotNull(audioService);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText_ValidatesParameters()
    {
        // Arrange
        var builder = Kernel.CreateBuilder();

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentNullException>(() => builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(null!));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(""));
        Assert.Throws<ArgumentException>(() => builder.AddAzureOpenAIAudioToText(" \t"));
    }
}

        // Assert registration happened
        Assert.Contains(services, d => d.ServiceType == typeof(IAudioToTextService) && d.Lifetime == ServiceLifetime.Singleton);

        const string serviceId = "test-service";

        // Assert

        Assert.NotNull(Assert.Single(audioServices));
    }
